mapper.select: SELECT summary_id, meeting_id, lang, meeting_date, meeting_title, participants, participant_count, summary, meeting_score, risk_level, topics, decisions, action_items, risks, improvements, next_steps, created_at, updated_at FROM tl_meeting_summaries WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND lang = #{lang} ORDER BY summary_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.summary_id, s.meeting_id, s.lang, s.meeting_date, s.meeting_title, s.participants, s.participant_count, s.summary, s.meeting_score, s.risk_level, s.topics, s.decisions, s.action_items, s.risks, s.improvements, s.next_steps, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM tl_meeting_summaries s JOIN tl_meetings m ON s.meeting_id = m.meetings_id WHERE m.host_id = #{userId} AND s.lang = #{lang} ORDER BY s.meeting_date DESC, s.summary_id DESC
